title: Supporting someone in crisis
citation: Leaune, E., & Bui, E. (2025). A (global) mental health crisis? International Journal of Mental Health, 54(4), 414-416.
content:
Supporting someone in crisis.

Supporting someone in a mental health crisis does not mean having all the answers. Often, the most helpful approach is to stay calm, listen without judgement and let the person know they do not have to face the situation alone. Avoid trying to immediately solve the problem or minimise what they are experiencing. Simply being present, encouraging professional support and offering practical help can provide reassurance during a very difficult time.
